---
name: Knowledge correction
about: Correct an indexed claim, record, or shared knowledge policy with evidence.
---

## Affected record or policy

Identify the record or section and the applicable index release or revision.

## Proposed correction

Describe what should change and why.

## Evidence

Give source citations with revisions and precise locators. Identify normative text, interpretation, or observed behavior as applicable. For observations, include verification steps and relevant versions and conditions.

## Impact and uncertainty

Identify related records, versions, or cross-index references if known. Note conflicting evidence or limits.
